items.title: 9.1.3 How Does Design Thinking Apply to Business Solutions? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.1.3 (PDF 209), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Karobar ki duniya mein Design Thinking companies ko aise products aur services banane mein madad deti hai jo log waqai chahte hain aur jin ki unhein zaroorat hai. Maslan koi company Design Thinking se aisi nayi app bana sakti hai jis se online khana order karna aasan ho jaye. User experience (user ka tajurba) par focus de kar aur mukhtalif ideas aazma kar woh aisa hal bana sakti hai jo istemal mein aasan (user-friendly) bhi ho aur market mein kamyab bhi.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
Aayiye apne college ke ek masle par Design Thinking lagayein. Farz karein students ko homework ka waqt nahi milta kyunke college ke baad un ki bohat si activities hain. Yeh masla kaise hal karenge?
1. Empathize: classmates se baat karein aur samjhein ke woh is situation (halaat) ke bare mein kya mehsoos karte hain.
2. Define: classmates se jo seekha us ki base par asal masla likhein.
3. Ideate: groups mein mil kar sochein ke students apna waqt behtar kaise manage kar sakte hain.
4. Prototype: ek saada plan ya schedule (time table) banayein jo activities aur homework mein balance (tawazun) laye.
5. Test: apna plan doosre students ko dikhayein aur poochein ke kya yeh chalega. Zaroorat ho to tabdeeliyan karein.
Yeh activity aap ko Design Thinking ki mashq karwayegi aur dikhayegi ke yeh rozmarra ke masail hal karne mein kaise kaam aati hai.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: jin students ko after-school activities ki wajah se homework ka waqt nahi milta, un par Design Thinking lagayein. Har qadam se kya nikal sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Empathize: baat cheet se pata chalta hai ke students jaldi mein aur thake hue rehte hain. Define: 'students ko activities ke saath homework fit karne ka tareeqa chahiye'. Ideate: mil kar istemal hone wala planner, college mein homework ka ek ghanta, hafte ke dinon mein kam activities. Prototype: hafte ke time table ka saada draft. Test: students ek hafta aazma kar tabdeeliyan batate hain, jo agle version mein shamil hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Business solutions banane mein Design Thinking ki ahmiyat misalon ke saath bataiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: Design Thinking aisi cheez banane ka risk (khatra) kam karti hai jo koi na chahe, kyunke yeh users ki asal zarooraton se shuru hoti hai aur bara kharcha karne se pehle saste prototypes se ideas aazmati hai. Yeh bohat se ideas sochne par zor deti hai, is liye hal zyada creative hote hain, aur baar baar ki testing product ko qadam ba qadam behtar karti hai. Misalein: users ki testing se behtar hui food-ordering app; students ki shikayaton se bana naya school bag; grocery store jo customers se un ki pareshani pooch kar home delivery shuru karta hai.

items: Design Thinking user ki zaroorat par tawajjo aur ideas aazma kar kamyab products banati hai (food-ordering app).
